newsitem.title: CANADA: Five dead in apparent Canadian multiple murder.
newsitem.headline: Five dead in apparent Canadian multiple murder.

text.p: The bodies of five people were discovered on a farm near this rural community in an apparent multiple slaying, police said on Thursday.
"Five bodies were located and all are being treated as murders," police said in a statement. They declined to identify the victims.
Police were called on Wednesday to the farm about 50 miles southeast of Vancouver after neighbors said they had not seen the farm's inhabitants for more than a day.
Authorities found one woman and a man in an outbuilding on the farm and two men and a woman inside the farmhouse.
The Canadian Press news agency reported that neighbors said the farm was run by Raymond Graves, 69, who lived there with his wife Sonto, 56, and a son.

In March, the couple were arrested and charged with attempted murder after a six-hour standoff with police. Police closed in after someone shot a 38-year-old man in nearby Chilliwack, the agency said.
